```{r score MAP-SR}
# Code script to score the Motivation and Pleasure Scale - Self-Report (MAP-SR) - Llerena et al. (2013)
# https://doi.org/10.1016/j.comppsych.2012.12.001
# Scoring instructions: The raw scores of all the 15 items are summed to obtain a total raw score that ranges from 0 to 60. Higher scores reflect lower pathology. Subscores are also calculated as follows:
  #social pleasure subscore: sum items 1-3
  #recreational/work pleasure subscore: sum items 4-6
  #feelings and motivations about close, caring relationships subscore: sum items 7-9
  #motivation and effort to engage in activities subscore: sum items 10-15

# Load required packages 
library(dplyr)
library (readr)

# Load data
MAPSSR <- read_tsv("/Users/bsevchik/projects/EF_clinical/self-report/scale_csvs_Jan/separate_tsvs/mapssr.tsv")

# Compute total scores for each individual participant
MAPSSR <- MAPSSR %>%
  mutate(
    mapssr_social_total = rowSums(select(., mapssr_1, mapssr_2, mapssr_3), na.rm = TRUE),
    mapssr_recvoc_total = rowSums(select(., mapssr_4, mapssr_5, mapssr_6), na.rm = TRUE),
    mapssr_motrelation_total = rowSums(select(., mapssr_7, mapssr_8, mapssr_9), na.rm = TRUE),
    mapssr_engage_total = rowSums(select(., mapssr_10, mapssr_11, mapssr_12, mapssr_13, mapssr_14, mapssr_15), na.rm = TRUE),
    mapssr_total_score  = rowSums(select(., mapssr_1, mapssr_2, mapssr_3, mapssr_4, mapssr_5, mapssr_6, mapssr_7, mapssr_8, mapssr_9, mapssr_10, mapssr_11, mapssr_12, mapssr_13, mapssr_14, mapssr_15), na.rm = TRUE)
  )%>%
  rename_with(tolower) # lowercase 
write_tsv(MAPSSR,"/Users/bsevchik/projects/EF_clinical/self-report/scale_csvs_Jan/final_scored_tsvs/mapssr.tsv", na = "n/a")
```
``` {r MAP-SR distribution}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

MAPSSR %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = mapssr_social_total)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 20) +
  labs(x = "MAP-SR Social pleasure total", y = "Number of sessions",
       title = "Distribution of MAP-SR Social pleasure scores")

MAPSSR %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = mapssr_recvoc_total)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 20) +
  labs(x = "MAP-SR Recreational/Work pleasure total", y = "Number of sessions",
       title = "Distribution of MAP-SR Recreational/Work pleasure scores")

MAPSSR %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = mapssr_motrelation_total)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 20) +
  labs(x = "MAP-SR Motivation/Relationships total", y = "Number of sessions",
       title = "Distribution of MAP-SR Motivation/Relationships scores")

MAPSSR %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = mapssr_engage_total)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 20) +
  labs(x = "MAP-SR Engage (motivation/effort) total", y = "Number of sessions",
       title = "Distribution of MAP-SR Engage scores")

MAPSSR %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = mapssr_total_score)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 20) +
  labs(x = "MAP-SR Total score (0–60)", y = "Number of sessions",
       title = "Distribution of MAP-SR Total scores")

```
